title: Top entity instantiates a sub-entity via direct `entity work.X(arch) port map(...)`

problemDescription: Top entity `ent_inst_top` instantiates a counter sub-entity using the canonical VHDL'93+ direct-instantiation form `dut : entity work.counter8(rtl) port map (...)` — no `component ... end component;` declaration in the parent. SourceElaborator's InstanceRe regex already recognises this form; this case locks in that the full path (parser + elaborator + sim) works end to end.
